_readme: Strings whose CORRECT translation into a given language is byte-identical to the English. scripts/check-locale-translation.js consults this so a right translation is not reported as an untranslated one. This is a ledger, not a suppression list: every entry names the page that surfaced it and why the two forms coincide, and an entry is only ever added after confirming the locale page really does render the right word. Never add an entry to silence a genuine miss — translate the string instead. Entries are grouped by locale code and sorted by the string.

_schema.string: the exact extracted string, as it appears on both pages
_schema.reason: why the correct translation coincides with the English
_schema.found_on: the locale page that first surfaced it
